name: hybrid_b
description: Region bisection, half A. Carries the +60 save with the LAST five differing regions (0x00EBC-0x038DC) replaced by the corresponding bytes from the offset-0 save. Same squad shrink as the other probes so one short fight decides. If this reads 25 the cause lives in those regions; if 85 it lives in the first five, which hybrid_a carries.
